notes.title: Summer Tournaments Announced!
notes.content:
Get ready to take flight, pilots!We're excited to announce the WarBirds 2025 Summer Tournament Series, where veteran aces and fresh recruits alike can test their skill in intense historical air battles all season long!
Winners receive:

1st Place: 2 months subscription to WarBirds2025

2nd Place: 1 month subscription to WarBirds2025

3rd Place:  ½ month subscription to WarBirds2025


✈️ D-Day Breakout
Dates: Sunday, June 8 & Sunday, June 22
Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Take part in this two-part event as we reenact the breakout from Normandy in epic fashion.


🌊 Battle of the Coral Sea
Dates: Saturday, July 13 & Saturday, July 27

Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Fly in the Pacific Theatre as carrier-based fighters clash over the open ocean. Bring your best!


🔥 August Campaign Battles
Dates: Sunday, August 10 & Sunday, August 24

Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Two intense frames of WWII combat featuring surprise mission parameters and all-out warfare.


🏁 Valley Combat Target Race
Date: Sunday, September 7

Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Race through a treacherous valley in this fast-paced, low-altitude combat challenge. Precision flying and sharp shooting required!




Mark your calendars, squad up, and get your aircraft ready.
 Stay tuned for exact start times and mission briefings in the official WarBirds Discord and forums.

Let the skies burn and the legends rise. See you out there, pilots!
